session_1.speaker: Iris
session_1.text: Hi Tom! How was your week?

session_1.speaker: Tom
session_1.text: Busy. I started a new job at the observatory in Granada.

session_1.speaker: Iris
session_1.text: That sounds amazing. I adopted a kitten named Miso yesterday.

session_1.speaker: Iris
session_1.text: She is grey with white paws.

session_1.speaker: Tom
session_1.text: I have to go, the night shift starts soon.

session_2.speaker: Tom
session_2.text: Hey Iris, do you remember the observatory job I mentioned?

session_2.speaker: Iris
session_2.text: Of course, how is it going?

session_2.speaker: Tom
session_2.text: Great, we photographed a comet last Tuesday.

session_2.speaker: Iris
session_2.text: Wow. I signed up for a climbing course in Lyon.
session_2.blip_caption: a photo of a climbing wall

session_2.speaker: Tom
session_2.text: Climbing suits you. When does it start?

session_3.speaker: Iris
session_3.text: Tom, Miso knocked my plant off the shelf again.

session_3.speaker: Tom
session_3.text: Ha, kittens. How is the climbing going?

session_3.speaker: Iris
session_3.text: I finished the first wall last weekend and my arms hurt.

session_3.speaker: Tom
session_3.text: My sister Ana is visiting Granada next month.

session_3.speaker: Iris
session_3.text: You should take her to the observatory.

When did Tom photograph a comet?
Where is Iris's climbing course and when did it start?
